case_title: HARIS RAFTIS VS. CHOW BROTHERS, INC. DBA AUTOMOTIVE SPECIALISTS

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $4,236.49 FILED BY RAFTIS, HARIS AS TO DEFENDANT CHOW BROTHERS, INC. DBA AUTOMOTIVE SPECIALISTS ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR OCT-27-2010 AT 08:30 AM IN DEPT 506
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF (SERVICE FEE $30.00) SERVED SEP-30-2010, PERSONAL SERVICE AS TO DEFENDANT CHOW BROTHERS, INC. DBA AUTOMOTIVE SPECIALISTS
DECLARATION OF APPEARANCE ON BEHALF OF CORPORATION PURSUANT TO CCP 116.540 (B)-(H) FILED BY DEFENDANT CHOW BROTHERS, INC. DBA AUTOMOTIVE SPECIALISTS

SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF OCT-27-2010. APPEARANCE BY PLAINTIFF AND DEFENDANT, NO EXHIBITS DETAINE BY THE COURT. MATTER TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF OCT-27-2010 BY JPT. DAVID LAVINE. CLERK: S. RAVINANTAPRICHA, NOT REPORTED. (506)
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF OCT-27-2010 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF RAFTIS, HARIS IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT CHOW BROTHERS, INC. DBA AUTOMOTIVE SPECIALISTS PLAINTIFF DID NOT MEET HIS BURDEN TO SHOW TRANSMISSION FAILURE WAS DUE TO OVERFILLING FLUID BY DEFENDANT. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS NO EXHIBITS FILED
LETTER TO THE JUDGE PRO TEM DAVID LAVINE FILED BY PLAINTIFF RAFTIS, HARIS

ORDER ON PLAINTIFF'S 1-14-2011 FILING-RESPONSE: WHILE PLAINTIFF SHOWED THAT 1) DEFENDANT OVERFILLED THE TRANSMISSION FLUID LEVEL, AND (2) THERE WAS SERIOUS DAMAGE TO HIS CAR, HE FAILED TO CONVINCE US HOW BY PRESENTATION OF SCIENTIFIC EVIDENCE OR ANY OTHER, THAT THE EXCESS FLUID CAUSED THE DAMAGE TO HIS CAR. WHETHER OVERFILLED TRANSMISSION FLUID CAN CAUSE THE DAMAGE AT ISSUE IN THIS CASE IS AN OPEN QUESTION WHICH WAS NOT PROVEN TO THE COURT'S SATISFACTION.
